_readme: S409 SkyOcotillo, 2026-10-17. Merced's catalog is Coursedog at catalog.mccd.edu. Hartnell's Coursedog page fetched its program list and a whole-catalog PDF from the vendor's API as it loaded (run 39077713662); this read loads Merced's programs view with "network": true to find the same two calls. Pages only, no model call, no table write.
